blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala and partner Zeynep Sonmez of Turkiye crashed out in the first round of the Wuhan Open on Tuesday night in China. Eala and Sonmez were eliminated by Ukrainians Dayana Yastremska and Anhelina Kalinina, 2-6 3-6, in the round of 32. The loss ended Eala’s brief stint in Wuhan, where she suffered a shock loss to 217th-ranked Chinese Shi Han, 6-4, 3-6, 3-6, in the round of 64 late Monday night. The Wuhan Open marked Eala’s return on Tour after skipping the China Open and representing the Philippines at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Japan. It’s been a banner […]...
